name: glimpse-windows
title: Glimpse
description: Glimpse windows + portable GAPP browser (by project, history, isolated runner)
author: dwsy

commands.name: browse-gapps
commands.title: Browse GAPPs
commands.description: GAPPs by project — open, history, enable/archive (no Pi required)

commands.name: run-gapp
commands.title: Run Last GAPP
commands.description: Open the most recently run GAPP with isolated SDK runner

commands.name: list-windows
commands.title: Switch Glimpse Window
commands.description: Browse open Glimpse windows and activate one

commands.name: focus-active
commands.title: Focus Active Glimpse Window
commands.description: Bring the key Glimpse window to the front

scripts.build: ray build -e dist -o dist && node scripts/sync-root-executables.mjs
